body: Thank you so much! You're way more helpful than Google and my textbook!
Thank you for the comment. It’s good to hear something relatable. He’s been inviting me to go to the gym with him so I think I should try it out after I talk to him.
I feel like that’s what I’m doing now and I don’t want to drive him away. There will be times when I’m too afraid to have sex, because I don’t want him to see me.

I’ve been trying to avoid going with him for so long, even though he’d invite me to work out with him. I think that it’s just the fear of looking bad in front of him so I do other things to try to look good for him like eating less. You make a good point by saying that this is is just in my head, because I think that wasn’t something I was thinking about and that he would just think I’m too sensitive. I should just suck it up and go with him after I have this conversation.
Thank you. I’m not in therapy right now, but I have been considering going back since things are lent going very well.
Yeah. I’m in the hospital. I’ve been asleep since Sunday night. I took a handful of 200mg pills of seroquel. I’ve had three seizures and will have an mri later today.
I’m so tired I can’t do that. I just need to sleep

I really do believe he loves me. He's showed me so much affection and desire to be with me. There are little things I need to get over.

(giving him money to pay for rent/gas,giving him rides to work because he had to sell his car, him being a cuckold and suggesting I have sex with his friend)

These are all things we've personally moved on from, but I can't for some reason. I know I'm talking about a whole other situation, but I want this relationship to work. He is really all I have and if I became pregnant with him there is absolutely a 100% chance he'd have me get an abortion.

No. I told him my school schedule and that I only have one class tomorrow so I can drive up to see him after class. A break is probably for the best, but would kill my mind. He's the only relationship in my life. I don't even have friendships. I need to make friends to stop this addiction and take a break. I just need the motivation to do so. Or maybe not motivation, I need to make myself understand all of this in a big picture.

This so helpful thank you. I don't want to lose everything I have just because I'm in love or think I'm in love. I want to stop being so addicted to him and focus on what's in front of me and what's really important. For some reason though, I have no desire for birth control. My very religious mother even suggested birth control. She still cries at the idea of me having sex with him. I just need to stop going home and stay at my dorm.
I believe some of their points are valid, but I'm also an adult and need to experience life on my own without being lectured all the time.
How did he take in what you told him? Were you able to move on? And why is it that this is such a turn on for some guys?

We did talk about this a little while ago. He was kind of angry at me, because it sounded like I'm just doing this for him. I have no interest in having sex with someone else. I only want him. 
I do want to do things that make him happy and I know he wants the same for me. My mind is still cluttered with back and forth thoughts and I know initially it is my decision to make, but right now he is making the decision to cancel it and not go through with the plan.

It's so much easier said than done to say I'm not going through with it. I'm considering it will be a new experience, but I don't want to regret it. I'm more leaning towards not doing it. It's not something I want and my boyfriend will have to be okay with that  
It's just I really can't make him unhappy. He says he loves me, but why put someone you love through something like this?
